text:
Priya S: Morning — async check-in for hawthorne renewal. What I did: triaged customer webhook errors, identified duplicate deliveries for renewals queue causing double-charges in staging. Blockers: need eng to confirm idempotency header handling and a safe retry limit. Today: request CR + patch, then coordinate a brief canary with the customer. 

Marco L: Thanks Priya. Can you paste the error sample and the failing payload? I want to reproduce locally. If it's idempotency we'll add an X-Idempotency header and short-circuit duplicates.

Priya S: Sending sample below. Note: we saw repeated 502s followed by duplicate accepts. Payload truncated.

Priya S: ```
{
  "customer_id": "hawthorne-22",
  "invoice_id": "inv_9f3a",
  "attempt": 3,
  "items": [...]
}
2026-03-16T09:12:34Z ERROR webhook-deliverer 502 Bad Gateway id=hk-231
```

Jin K: I pushed a small fix branch that guards the delivery loop and sets an `X-Idempotency-Key`. PR: https://git.redwood/infer/merge_requests/4523 — needs review for correct header propagation across retries. The core change is 4 lines in deliverer.go.

Marco L: Looking now. Quick note: make sure the header is respected by the proxy layer (we saw it stripped in a previous rollout). Also add a telemetry tag `webhook.idempotency` so ops can confirm dedupe in realtime.

Priya S: @Marco L @Jin K great. Can we get a quick CR today? Customer renewal window closes EOD Thursday — customer is paused on auto-renew until this is stable.

Maya (CS Ops): I can hold the handoff for the canary and coordinate with Hawthorne success contact (Ellis). I have a test token and a small subset of invoices to run. Ping me when PR merges and I'll run warm canary. :white_check_mark:

Marco L: I'll review PR now, should be small. If green, I'll merge and tag eng-oncall for a 30m rollout and monitor `webhook.idempotency` spikes.

Jin K: Thanks. If Marco approves I'll rebase and resolve the one lint nit. Expect merge by ~11:30am PT.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy created: canary/webhook-fix-4523 -> staging at 2026-03-16T11:45:00Z (owner: Marco L).

Priya S: Perfect — once canary is healthy I'll coordinate the renewals resume and message the customer. If we see any duplicate charge attempts in the next hour please flag here with `duplicate-id=INV_9F3A` and I'll escalate.

Marco L: Quick ask for Jin: add this check in unit tests to assert header present on retry path. One-liner should do it.

Jin K: On it. Will update PR.

Priya S: Thanks team — i'll update the renewal ticket and post back after canary. :pray:

Maya (CS Ops): I'll prepare the email template for Ellis in case we need to pause/resume outside normal window.

Priya S: last note: customer asks for timeline in case we need to manual-credit — I'll include tentative merge + canary timeframe.

Marco L: Good plan.
